create_JanusProcessor: create a JanusProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal generation
call_JanusProcessor: call the JanusProcessor to tokenize text and images into input_ids and pixel_values for model inference
postprocess_JanusProcessor: postprocess generated image outputs from the Janus model using the image processor's postprocess method
post_process_multimodal_output: post_process_multimodal_output to decode model generation outputs as text or images based on generation_mode
configure_JanusTextKwargs: configure JanusTextKwargs with generation_mode set to text or image for controlling processor output modality
